articles.title: Goldman Sachs Says Prolonged War 'Will Hit Europe'
articles.summary: Sharon Bell, senior European equity strategist at Goldman Sachs, discusses the corporate earnings season, the artificial intelligence buildout and the potential impact of a drawn-out Middle East war on Europe's economies. She speaks on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
